units.source_text: 先前养的那只小狗无疑也是猎狐㹴，狗店通称“日本㹴”，

en.t: The little dog they had kept before was undoubtedly a fox terrier too, commonly called a "Japanese terrier" by dog dealers,

units.source_text: 就是在日本体形有点走形的公狗“顺利㹴”，

en.t: a male "Junri terrier" whose shape had become somewhat distorted in Japan,

units.source_text: 不知丈夫是从哪里要来的。

en.t: and she did not know where her husband had obtained it.

units.source_text: 丈夫从哪里怎么要来的，

en.t: As for where and how her husband had gotten it,

units.source_text: 夫人整整三个月蒙在鼓里一无所知地度日。

en.t: the lady spent a full three months completely in the dark, living without knowing a thing.
